viewing_check: Look at the stems and case for a sterling/STG SILVER/925 mark and Sargisons stamp on the spoons (photograph each stem and underside of bowls); weigh if possible (sterling set about 45 to 55 g); check all six match and nothing is dented or missing; note if gum leaf finials are intact.
